divergences.old: deps outdated and deps license-check scanning the direct dependencies of the git repository they ran in, and failing with "Not inside a git repository." elsewhere
divergences.toil: toil artifactory outdated and license-check (deps outdated and deps license-check are aliases) read an inventory from --from <file>, or from stdin on the CLI: toil deps scan | toil artifactory outdated. --ecosystem, --include-dev and the direct-only filter apply to the inventory as they applied to the scan
divergences.why: One command talks to one source and the caller composes them (decision 6 on #68). Scanning is deps scan's job; these commands only ask Artifactory.

divergences.old: deps outdated and deps license-check pinging the public OSV service, and Artifactory, before running, and ignoring OSV's answer
divergences.toil: Only Artifactory is pinged. OSV is never contacted by these commands
divergences.why: toil sends traffic to a public API only when the command names it; these name Artifactory.

divergences.old: deps outdated and deps license-check, when the Artifactory ping fails, saying "Run 'deps connectivity' to diagnose", and caching the ping's result for the life of the process
divergences.toil: The message says "Run 'toil artifactory ping' to diagnose" (code AUTH when the token was rejected, NETWORK otherwise, details.status 503), and every call pings afresh
divergences.why: toil has no deps connectivity command, so the recorded advice would point at nothing; and a long-lived MCP server would otherwise repeat a cached failure, or a cached success, for its whole life.

divergences.old: artifactory ping, and the outdated and license-check lookups, sent with no 429 retry, following redirects to any host, and with lookup URLs joined to baseUrl as plain text
divergences.toil: They go through core's HTTP layer like every other command: a 429 is retried as it is for the rest of the area's calls, a redirect to another host is refused (a failed lookup still counts as no answer), and a base URL ending in / doesn't produce //api
divergences.why: Credentials stay on the connection's host, and every request in toil is sent one way. The answers are otherwise the same.

divergences.old: artifactory builds --timeout <s> bounding only the request, with no limit on the command
divergences.toil: The command is allowed 600 s, so --timeout up to 600 works as the contract records; a longer one is cut short with TIMEOUT unless TOIL_TIMEOUT_MS is raised
divergences.why: Every command has a time limit and can be cancelled.
